description.short_caption: Erythema and crusting in the external ear canal.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the external ear and ear canal of a patient. There is erythema, crusting, and debris visible within the external auditory canal, suggestive of inflammation or infection. The surrounding skin appears mildly erythematous, and there is no obvious swelling of the auricle. A gold earring is visible in the earlobe.
visible_findings: erythema in the external auditory canal
crusting and debris within the canal
mild erythema of the surrounding skin

description.short_caption: Clinical image of the external ear showing debris and possible infection.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the external ear canal of a patient. There is visible yellowish-green debris and crusting within the canal, suggestive of an infectious or inflammatory process. The surrounding skin appears mildly erythematous. A gloved hand is seen retracting the ear for better visualization.
visible_findings: yellowish-green debris in the ear canal
crusting within the external ear canal
mild erythema of the surrounding skin

description.short_caption: Fluorescent antibody staining showing VZV-positive cells.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a dark field with scattered bright green fluorescence, consistent with fluorescent antibody staining. The green fluorescence highlights cells or structures that are positive for varicella-zoster virus (VZV). The technique uses antibodies tagged with a fluorescent dye to detect viral antigens. The image is de-identified and does not provide anatomical context.
